text: I will do without your pity. But I would have saved you from uttering what you will regret.” “I am going away now. I shall leave you.” “You need not go, as I am going myself. You will keep just as far away from me by staying here.” “Call her to mind—think of her—what goodness there was in her—it showed in every line of her face! Most women, even when but slightly annoyed, show a flicker of evil in some curl of the mouth or some corner of the cheek; but as for her, never in her angriest moments was there anything malicious in her look.
